name: Victor
description: Victor — Noxverse character on the shared rig: a wealthy private collector. Tan cap, olive jacket-hoodie with cream drawstrings, charcoal trousers, white sneakers. Use for collectors, dealers, buyers, rich older side characters.
style: Flat vector, 7px outlines, minimal dot-eye faces; drawn in code by make.mjs (free, deterministic). Reads at phone size down to ~300 px tall.

poseNotes.stand-worried: arms down, worried brows, sweat drop — default 'you' pose, the hook
poseNotes.stand-smug: arms crossed, smug closed-eye smile — the plan, false confidence
poseNotes.hands-up-shock: hands up by the head, wide eyes, open mouth — caught, panic
poseNotes.sign-focused: right hand forward holding a pen, eyes down — signing, writing, paying; hand at ~(54%, 61%) of the box
poseNotes.stand-sideeye: arms down, eyes looking right, sweat — suspicion; put the threat (door, cop, phone) on the RIGHT
poseNotes.phone-worried: phone held to the right ear, worried brows, sweat — on a call, lost, waiting
poseNotes.phone-shock: phone at the ear, wide eyes, open mouth — the moment something happens mid-call
poseNotes.point-worried: right arm out pointing right, worried — "that one", accusing, noticing; put the target on the RIGHT
poseNotes.point-shock: pointing right, wide eyes, open mouth — "THAT'S my landlord", the reveal
poseNotes.shrug-smug: elbows out, open hands up, smug — "what can you do?", false innocence
poseNotes.shrug-worried: shrug with worried brows + sweat — helpless, "no idea"

headNotes.shock: wide eyes, open mouth — vote / cliffhanger cards, reaction cut-ins
headNotes.worried: worried brows, sweat — ID photos, TV/news, missing posters

animation: Use the noxverse/character component: it is LIVE by default (drawn every frame by the rig) — breathes, blinks, glances, shifts weight, drips sweat. Never add a loop on top of it.
Idle acting follows the face (worried/sideeye → nervous, smug → smug, shock → shock, focused → focused); override with idle: calm|nervous|smug|shock|focused|still, scale with amount (0.5 subtler).
Put the threat (door, cop, phone) on one side and set look: left|right so the eyes rest there.

Acting: acting beats change pose/face on the word that motivates them (anticipation → overshooting move → settle; face swaps hide in a blink), shift where he looks (eyes → head → body), or play a gesture: nod, shake, shrug, flinch, gulp, take, lookBack, point. 2–4 beats a shot with holds between; give repeated poses different seeds.

Talking: talk: true lip-syncs only his own dialogue lines (VO (Nox): … in the script, spoken in his saved voice); talk: "all" mouths every line (on-screen narrator); talk: [ids] picks lines. The head dips and brows lift on stressed syllables, eyes steady, a blink as each line ends.

Second-person narration ("You just…") is not Nox speaking: he reacts and his mouth rests. His own lines are dialogue in the script (VO (Nox): …); give him talk: true in every shot where he might speak.
Mouth shapes: characters/nox/mouths.png (node rig.mjs nox --mouths) — 9 shapes bent to each face's emotion; the smug smirk stays while he talks.
Give the character its own depth (z 0.6–0.7) between background (0.1) and foreground props (0.8) so camera pushes create parallax.
Full body 450–800 px tall; bust 600–760 px; ground the feet on a floor/shore line (feet at 92% of the box).
Front-facing only: show direction with eyes (sideeye, look) and with where props sit, not by turning the body.
live: false places the old still PNG (with a breathe loop) — only for decks or matching a finished video.
addPose: Add an entry to poses (arms: down|crossed|up|sign|phone|point|shrug; face: worried|smug|shock|focused|sideeye; sweat) or heads, then: node studio/library/universes/noxverse/rig.mjs nox. New arms/faces go in rig-parts.mjs (ARMS, FACE_PARTS — eyes, brows and mouth kept separate so the live rig can blink and talk) (shared by every Noxverse character).
